records.name: 13, Bath Terrace
records.notes: BLYTH BATH TERRACE NZ 3181 SE and NZ 38 SW 12/29 and 2/29 No. 13 16.11.81 GV II House, early C19. Rendered and whitewashed; Welsh slate roof. 2 storeys, 3 bays, symmetrical. Renewed door in stone doorcase with engaged columns supporting impost frieze extended above side columns. Fanlight above, the whole within round-arched recess. 4-pane sash windows with wedge lintels and slightly-projecting sills. Stone-coped gable to right; end stacks. Rear elevation shows margined sash stair window with C19 coloured glass. ,
